title: Marchland Oaths 1.6.0 exported public binary smoke
command: <public exe> --audio-driver Dummy --rendering-method gl_compatibility --resolution 1280x720 --quit-after 900 in a throwaway profile
scope: The shipped Windows executable boots, runs its real title flow for 900 frames and exits with no script errors. Because the engine is asked to quit between frames, ObjectDB warnings about objects still alive at exit are recorded as forced-exit artifacts; the ordered-teardown soak is the leak evidence. This is a boot smoke test, not a playthrough.
